title: Define an Rducks execution plan — rducks_execution_plan
text: marshalling Chunk marshalling implementation. "arrow_r" uses Arrow C Data plus nanoarrow/R materialization reference implementation. "arrow_c" uses native C/DuckDB-vector materialization supported scalar-UDF evaluation modes. "arrow_ipc" uses Arrow IPC bytes explicit task/result payload NNG multiprocess path. concurrency Concurrency contract. "serial" evaluates one chunk time calling process. "inproc_concurrent" allows -process DuckDB callback concurrency keeping R API work serialized recorded main R thread. "multiprocess_parallel" uses persistent NNG/nanonext workers process-isolated chunk work requires marshalling = "arrow_ipc". ipc_endpoints NULL, Rducks starts local worker loops mirai daemons; otherwise endpoint URLs passed unchanged. ipc_globals, ipc_packages, ipc_timeout, ipc_endpoints, ipc_transport Arrow IPC worker options. default (ipc_globals = "auto"), Rducks discovers scalar-UDF globals registration-wrapper creation broadcasts NNG worker scalar UDF registered shared provider pool. Automatic capture estimates serialized globals payload warns exceeds option rducks.ipc_globals.warn_bytes (8 MiB default); option rducks.ipc_globals.max_bytes can set hard byte limit. Set ipc_globals_share = "mori" pass selected globals mori shared memory references -host workers; Rducks keeps shared objects anchored registered scalar UDF lifetime. Use ipc_packages packages workers attach, ipc_globals = FALSE rely serialized UDF closure explicit task state, character vector / named list explicit extra globals. ipc_timeout positive finite provider wait timeout seconds; NULL uses finite default 30 seconds. ipc_endpoints optionally supplies NNG endpoint URLs worker processes caller starts stops; processes must run Rducks NNG worker loop. NNG URL transport supported endpoints allowed. endpoints supplied, ipc_transport selects transport used mirai-launched local worker endpoints must left NULL explicit ipc_endpoints supplied. Rducks retries local TCP/WebSocket startup fresh endpoint bundles startup-ping failure; caller-supplied endpoints remain caller-owned fail fast. "abstract" means Linux abstract IPC, "ipc" means NNG IPC (Unix-domain sockets POSIX named pipes Windows), "unix" means POSIX Unix-domain alias, "tcp" / "ws" use loopback TCP / WebSocket endpoints. default "abstract" Linux "ipc" elsewhere. ipc_globals_share selected IPC globals represented worker broadcast. "none" serializes registration payload. "mori" applies mori::share() selected global serialization, can turn large atomic vectors, lists, data frames -host shared-memory references. requires optional mori package workers machine. ipc_provider Worker provider arrow_ipc + multiprocess_parallel. "nng" supported. NNG provider broadcasts registered scalar UDF closure plus discovered globals/packages every worker shared database-runtime provider pool, avoid capturing large objects UDF environments unless memory cost intended ipc_globals_share = "mori" appropriate. ipc_workers Number persistent NNG workers. ipc_max_pending Maximum simultaneous native NNG requests admitted per registered scalar-UDF client pool. NULL uses provider default 64. Non-IPC plans store NA_integer_ field. current provider still uses synchronous request/reply per callback rather collect-many batching, value enforced bounded pending/-flight guard callback enters native request path.
